from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document (e.g., 《判决文书a》)")
    document_type: str = Field(description="The formal document type (e.g., 民事判决书，行政裁定书，执行复议裁定书)")
    case_domain: str = Field(description="The broad legal domain (e.g., 民事，行政，执行)")
    cause_markers: List[str] = Field(description="List of key legal terms or facts extracted that indicate the specific cause of action (e.g., '先予执行', '海事', '行政拘留', '返还原物')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentRecord]
